description: This PHP test class tests the CandidateHiringAPI in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, focusing on API endpoints related to candidate hiring. It includes setup, placeholder tests for getOne, delete, and their validation, as well as a data-driven test for updating candidate hiring information.

classes.name: CandidateHiringAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the CandidateHiringAPI endpoint within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes setup and various test methods, some of which expect certain methods to be not implemented, and a data-driven test for the update operation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating the CandidateHistory table to ensure a clean state before each test.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of the CandidateHiringAPI, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rule retrieval for the getOne method, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Performs a data-driven test of the update method, involving fixture setup, mocking services, and validation.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the testUpdate method, loading from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method of the CandidateHiringAPI, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rule retrieval for the delete method, expecting a not implemented exception.
